Color identity: RG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite combat damage; Infinite combat phases; Infinite creature tokens with haste; Infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite untap of creatures you control
Start: Breath of Fury (battlefield: attached to any other creature you control); Cyclops of Eternal Fury (battlefield); Scepter of Celebration (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
  At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
  Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
  Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
  Repeat each combat phase.

## Combo 3259-4478-7262
Cards: Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers + Breath of Fury + Roar of Resistance
Color identity: RG | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal
Produces: Near-infinite combat damage; Near-infinite combat phases; Near-infinite mana creatures you control can produce; Near-infinite untap of creatures you control; Near-infinite creature ETB; Near-infinite creature LTB; Near-infinite death triggers; Near-infinite creature sacrifice triggers
Start: Raph & Mikey, Troublemakers (battlefield); Breath of Fury (battlefield: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness); Roar of Resistance (battlefield)
Prerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
  An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Steps: Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
  Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
  Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
  Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
  Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
Notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

Start: Shifting Woodland (battlefield); Aftermath Analyst (graveyard); Lotus Cobra (battlefield); Need for Speed (battlefield)
Prerequisites: There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
  You control at least eight lands.
Steps: Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
  Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
  Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
  Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
  When the lands enter the battlefield, Lotus Cobra triggers that many times, adding {G} for each land that entered the battlefield this way.
  Repeat.
  If you control nine or more lands, this combo will net infinite mana due to Lotus Cobra's trigger.

  Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
Steps: Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
  Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
  Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
  Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
  When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
  During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
  Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
  Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
  Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
  Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
  Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping basic lands you control.
  Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
  Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
  Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
  Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
  Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
  Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Early Harvest with the copy.
  Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Early Harvest from your graveyard to your hand.
  Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
  Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
  Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
  Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
  Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
  Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
  Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
  Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Early Harvest.
  Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
  In response, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
  Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
  Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
  Repeat from step 18.
